Daiman doesssn't [sic] trussst [sic] anyone not to dessssert [sic].|Master Treece and Mrssk facing an obstacle during the first phase of Operation Influx on Oranessan|<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}}</ref>}}
'''Mrssk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[New Sith Wars]] and a member of [[Vannar Treece]]'s strike team. He participated in [[Operation Influx]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chelloa]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. Mrssk and his comrades [[Raid on Oranessan|infiltrated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oranessan]] in 1032 BBY. He also subsequently took part in a [[Raid on Chelloa|raid]] on [[Chelloa]], a producer of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]. Mrssk was subsequently killed in an explosion caused by baradium ignited by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s [[kinetic corruptor]]. He was known to have wielded a blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
===Jedi career===
Mrssk was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the last century of the [[New Sith Wars]]. During that period, the [[New Sith]] Empire had collapsed and various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] controlled large areas of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had shrunk to a rump state centered around the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and was defended from Sith invasion by a security cordon around the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. At an unknown period, Mrssk was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] by members of the Jedi Order and was trained as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Mrssk was an enigma among the Trandoshan species due to his Force sensitivity and his alignment with the Jedi and the Galactic Republic. During his Jedi career, Mrssk became acquinted with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]], a Jedi activist who led independent "knight errant" operation against Sith warlords in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

===Operation Influx===
In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Treece learnt that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] had begun mining baradium&mdash;a volatile compound used in the manufacture of explosives including [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]&mdash;on the planet [[Chelloa]] and was exporting large quantities of the compound to munitions factories near the front line. Treece feared that Daiman's baradium advantage would end the stalemated conflict in the Grumani sectory by giving him a distinct advantage over his Sith competitors and thus pose a greater threat to the Republic in the future.<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />Treece subsequently gained authorization from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]] to launch [[Operation Influx]]. This was a three-stage operation that involved infiltrating the [[Daimanate]] by landing at [[Oranessan]], a key transport hub; disrupting export operations on Bardium; and extraction to the Republic via a direct [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] leading to neutral space.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref>

Treece had learnt about the baradium operations from his old friend and undercover Jedi operative [[Gorlan Palladane]], the leader of the [[Chelloan resistance]]. Palladane and his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mechanic friend [[Skodo]] had used a stolen [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] to reactivate a hyperspace relay and communicate with Treece. However, the Sith Lord Odion had been monitoring the transmission and made preparations to invade Chelloa. The nihilistic Sith Lord believed that the planet's high concentration of baradium created an imbalance in the Force and thus had to be destroyed.<ref name="SWKE3">[[Knight Errant 3|''Knight Errant'' 3]]</ref> Treece assembled a motley volunteer force of Jedi that included friends who had worked in earlier "knight errant" operations with him, Jedi who distinguished themselves in other combat operations, and other acquaintances who owed him personal favors.<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

Since Dorvin had worked in earlier operations with Treece, he was recruited for Operation Influx. Other members of the team included the [[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]] [[Dorvin Eltrom]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Berluk]], who had earned distinction in combat. Treece was also taking advantage of a loophole in Genarra's edict that allowed Jedi Knights sixteen days of free travel anywhere in the galaxy between their regular routine of serving three months in law enforcement patrols and nine months of active service on the Republic's contracting frontiers.<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> Another member of the strike team was Treece's former apprentice [[Kerra Holt]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl who had been orphaned during the [[Chagras Hegemony]]'s [[Massacre of Aquilaris|conquest]] of her homeworld of [[Aquilaris Minor]] in [[1042 BBY]]. This marked Kerra's first return to her home sector after spending much of her adolescence with the Jedi on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

===Insertion at Oranessan===
The first stage of Operation Influx went smoothly with the Jedi team safely arriving on a starship at Oranessan. While descending into the planet's atmosphere, they intercepted and shot down a personnel shuttle carrying flight crew to a spaceport where a fleet of [[Heavy-Lift Starcrosser|Daimanate Heavy-Lift Starcrossers]] was awaiting departure for a delivery run to [[Chelloa]]. The shuttle crashed on top of a hillcrest in the mud flats and the Jedi quickly retrieved the fallen crew's cloaks and identification badges.<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

After killing a group of Daimanate sentries, the Jedi commandeered an empty Starcrosser transport from the spaceport's landing zone and prepared to depart for Chelloa. The Jedi planned to use the transport to take them to Chelloa, but discovered that the transport's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] was missing its [[activation cylinder]]. While the transport was still able to fly, it was unable to make a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace jump]]. Mrssk explained to his fellow Jedi that while it was standard protocol for Republic-registered vessels to carry their activation cylinders aboard the vessel, the Sith Lord Daiman did not allow his men to keep the devices aboard his ships to reduce desertion rates among his forces.<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

While Master Treece considered shifting to their fallback which involved heading back to their Jedi starship and using it to shoot down the departing Daimanate transports, Kerra disagreed because Daiman could easily re-route other ships within his realm to Chelloa. Undaunted by the challenges, Holt stole a replacement cylinder from a nearby hangar, and after fitting the device, the Jedi departed Oranessan.<ref name="Knight Errant: Influx" />

===Death on Chelloa===
During the [[Raid on Chelloa|second part of the operation]], the Jedi strike team landed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] town of [[Jenith]] where they overwhelmed a small Daimanate security force with the assistance of the Chelloan resistance. Their attack was interrupted by the arrival of Sith Lord [[Odion]]'s forces which had deployed a [[kinetic corruptor]] that ignited a large area of the surface. The ensuing explosion killed many Jedi, Daimanate guards and miners within the vicinity. Mrssk himself was killed during the explosion while Treece was slain by Odion during a lightsaber duel.<ref name="SWKE1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref>

The sole survivor was Kerra Holt who was sheltered by Palladane. She would go on to evacuate the planet's 63,000 inhabitants to the safety of Republic space after Daiman ignited the planet's surface with his own kinetic corruptors at the [[Destruction of Chelloa|end]] of the [[Chelloan affair]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> Despite Mrssk's death on Chelloa, the Jedi and the Republic continued with their effort against the Sith who were finally defeated at the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mrssk was first introduced as a supporting character in the new comic [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Knight Errant'']] comic series which debuted in [[August]] [[2010]] with the release of [[Knight Errant 0|''Knight Errant'' 0]] during [[Celebration V]]. His story background was developed by [[John Jackson Miller]], drawn by artist [[Federico Dallocchio]] and colored by [[Michael Atiyeh]]. He also appeared in the short story ''[[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx]]'' which was also written by Miller and explored the prelude on [[Oranessan]] prior to the events in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Aflame|''Aflame'']] story arc. This short story first debuted on [[October 19]], [[2010]] where he had a small speaking role consisting of just one line. Mrssk was killed off in [[Knight Errant 1|''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Aflame 1'']], the first issue of the [[Knight Errant 1|''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Aflame'']] story arc which was first released on [[October 13]], [[2010]].
